transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?

I feel like I’m constantly revved up at work, taking on too many projects at once and I can’t slow my mind or my pace down. It has gotten to the point where it's really affecting my job, and I just don't know how to stop.
Have you ever had a period where your mood was extremely high or irritable, and you felt like you didn’t need much sleep but still had lots of energy?

Yes, that describes exactly how I've been feeling for the past several months. I often feel on top of the world and buzzing with energy, but I get really snappy and irritated if anyone slows me down, like yelling at my mom over small things. I'll stay up until 3 or 4 AM working on spreadsheets, get only a couple of hours of sleep, and still wake up feeling completely wired.
Have there been times during these high-energy periods when you’ve made impulsive decisions—like spending a lot of money, acting recklessly, or doing things that were out of character for you?

Yeah, I actually have. I've charged a bunch of expensive software and business books to my credit card, and I've been driving way too fast late at night because I felt invincible. I even sent some flirty messages to a couple of clients, which I know could get me in trouble, but in the moment it just felt like part of this big, exciting plan.
